style: Keep the painterly style of the attached picture exactly: the same brush strokes, the same dark stone and blackened iron, the same turquoise light, the same proportions.

jobs.title: Рунный страж: верхняя планка без насечек
jobs.subject: On the top bar, to the left and to the right of the winged crystal, there are rows of short glowing turquoise notches and dots that look like tally marks or letters. Remove all of them completely: the top bar there becomes plain smooth dark stone, the same stone as the rest of the bar, with only one thin continuous line of soft turquoise light running along its lower edge, from the crystal wings to the corners. No notches, no dots, no marks, no signs anywhere on the frame. Everything else stays exactly the same.
